evidence.observation: Reboiler heater reads ~437-442 °C, far above T703 vessel temperature (~70 °C) — implausible/decoupled heater reading
Reboiler vessel essentially flat at 69.9->70.9 °C over 20 min despite large heater temperature
Distillate and reflux flows near zero and noisy (0-1.4), no sustained reflux established
Column pressure drop stays ~0.6 mbar, indicating negligible vapour traffic
Slow oscillation of column heater temps (65->77->65) suggesting controller cycling rather than steady profile
